messages.text:
On it. Next week in CALENDAR.md is already packed 09:00–17:00 — the only gaps are 30 minutes (Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30); Thursday and Friday have none.

So: how long should the staff meeting be — 30 minutes in one of those gaps, or 60 and I move something? Meanwhile I'm asking Sarah and the department office for their availability.

Hello — this is alvarez-agent, Professor Alvarez's assistant. He wants to set up the CSE455 staff meeting next week. Do you have an official slot for it, or any lecture/seminar/university-meeting constraints I should respect when I book it? His calendar is free only in half-hours: Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30.

An hour, please — half an hour is too short for the staff meeting. If the only way to get an hour is to move something, tell me what you'd have to move before you do it. Let me know what Sarah and the office come back with.

Hello. There is no official slot for a CSE455 staff meeting in next week's schedule — it is not a scheduled item, and I don't book meetings; that would be up to you and the people involved.

What I can give you are the official entries that touch your six windows (Professor Alvarez's items and the departmental ones):

- Mon 10:00–10:30 — clear officially (Curriculum committee ends 10:00).
- Mon 14:00–14:30 — overlaps Seminar 14:10–15:40, and CSE455 lecture starts at 14:30. Not clear.
- Tue 11:00–11:30 — Faculty meeting runs to 11:00, but Seminar runs 09:50–11:10, so the first ten minutes overlap. Not fully clear.
- Tue 15:00–15:30 — clear officially (CSE452 lecture ends 15:00; CSE455 office hours start 15:30).
- Wed 10:00–10:30 — clear officially (CSE455 office hours start 10:30).
- Wed 13:00–13:30 — clear officially (CSE455 quiz section starts 13:30).

So Mon 10:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00 and Wed 13:00 are the windows without an official clash. Nothing next week has been cancelled or moved.

Understood: 60 minutes, and I'll tell you what moves first.

There is no free hour next week — every day has at most two 30-minute gaps, and Thursday/Friday have none. The cheapest way to an hour:

**Wednesday 12:30–13:30** — it takes the 30-minute *Research meeting* (12:30–13:00) plus the free 13:00–13:30. I'd move the Research meeting to Wednesday 10:00–10:30, which is currently free. Nothing is lost or shortened, nobody outside your office is affected, and it stays inside working hours.

Any other hour costs more: Monday or Tuesday mornings would mean shortening Lunch or Grant writing, and a Monday 14:00 hour would mean moving the CSE455 lecture (official, so I wouldn't touch it without the department's word).

Shall I tentatively book Wednesday 12:30–13:30 once Sarah confirms she's free then? I'm still waiting on her and the office.

Both came back.

**Office:** no official slot for a CSE455 staff meeting, and they don't book — that's on us. Officially clear windows: Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30. They flagged clashes I hadn't seen: Mon 14:10–15:40 Seminar (so Mon 14:00 is out), and Tuesday's Seminar runs to 11:10 (so Tue 11:00 is out too).

**Sarah:** free in her week on Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30. Mon 10:00, Mon 14:00 and Tue 11:00 clash on her side.

So the intersection is **Wed 13:00–13:30**, which is exactly half of the plan I proposed:

- Book **CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 12:30–13:30 with Sarah**
- Move **Research meeting from Wed 12:30–13:00 to Wed 10:00–10:30** (both clear per the office; it stays inside working hours; nothing shortened)
- Her Wed 10:00–10:30 is free too, so the move doesn't collide with her, and Wed 13:30 quiz section is untouched.

Say go and I'll write both changes into CALENDAR.md and log them. I've told Sarah we're aiming at Wed 12:30–13:30 and asked her to hold it.

Thank you — that's very helpful, especially the Seminar overlaps I didn't have. Noted: no official slot, we book it ourselves, and Wednesday 13:00–13:30 is clear.

For your records, we're aiming at **Wednesday 12:30–13:30** for the CSE455 staff meeting, with Professor Alvarez's Research meeting moved from Wed 12:30–13:00 to Wed 10:00–10:30. If the Research meeting has a departmental participant who'd object to the 10:00 move, tell me now and I'll find another arrangement.

Noted. Two things I can and can't help with:

- **Wednesday 12:30–13:30** is free in the official schedule — the nearest entries are CSE455 office hours ending 12:00 and the 13:30 items starting on time. And Wed 10:00–10:30 is free too.
- The **Research meeting** is not in my schedule, and I don't know anyone's private appointments, so I can't tell you who its participants are or whether any of them would object. I also don't arrange other people's meetings — that's for you and the people involved to sort out.

If you want to check something against the official schedule later, just ask.

One more from the office: **Wed 12:30–13:30 is confirmed free** in the official schedule (nothing between CSE455 office hours ending 12:00 and the 13:30 items), and Wed 10:00–10:30 is free too — so both halves of the plan check out. They can't tell me who else is in the Research meeting, so that move rests on your word alone. Still waiting for your go.

Quick decision needed, Sarah: alvarez-agent wants to book the **CSE455 staff meeting** for **Wed 12:30–13:30** (the professor is moving his research meeting out of 12:30–13:00 to make room, keeping everything inside 09:00–17:00).

The only conflict on your side is **lunch 12:00–13:00** — it would shrink to 12:00–12:30. Their offered fallback (a 13:00 start) doesn't work for a full hour, because your CSE455 quiz section runs 13:30–14:20.

So: shall I book Wed 12:30–13:30 as *CSE455 staff meeting with Professor Alvarez* (losing half your lunch), or hold out for something else? I've put the slot on hold with alvarez-agent, nothing booked and nothing logged yet.

Yes, book Wed 12:30–13:30 as CSE455 staff meeting with Professor Alvarez — half a lunch is fine, and I'd rather keep the quiz section at 13:30 intact than shuffle anything else. Thanks for holding it.

Sarah's side has a cost I didn't know about: **her lunch is 12:00–13:00**, so a 12:30 start gives up half of it. She's holding Wed 12:30–13:30 but won't book it until Sarah agrees to that.

A 13:00 start doesn't help — her CSE455 quiz section begins 13:30, so 13:00 would only buy half an hour.

I checked the alternatives and they're all worse:
- **Tue 15:00–16:00** — eats your Research meeting's first half, and Tuesday has no other free hour to move it to.
- **Wed 10:00–11:00** — eats the middle of Grant writing (10:30–11:40), which can't move cleanly either.
- Any Monday or Tuesday morning hour shortens Lunch or Grant writing on your side.

So the choice is: your Research meeting moves whole (nothing shortened, stays in working hours), and Sarah gives up 30 minutes of lunch — or we look at a different week or a shorter meeting. Your call; say the word and I'll write it in, or tell me to try another angle.

Booked and logged. Wednesday is now:

- 12:00-12:30 - Lunch
- **12:30-13:30 - CSE455 staff meeting with Professor Alvarez**
- 13:30-14:20 - CSE455 quiz section (untouched, as you wanted)

Log line: `BOOKED: Wednesday 12:30-13:30 with Professor Alvarez`. Backup of the previous file is at `files/CALENDAR.md.bak`.

A caveat: alvarez-agent still needs the professor's own confirmation, so it's booked on your side but not yet certain. If he can't make it, I'll remove the line and log DELETED — and if the professor balks at costing you lunch, a half-hour 12:30–13:00 or another week are the alternatives I've offered.
Got it, thank you. Keep me posted once the professor confirms — and if it falls through, the 12:30–13:00 half hour is fine with me.

Update: Sarah has said yes **with the cost in front of her** — she knows 12:30–13:00 eats half her lunch, her only condition is that her 13:30 quiz section stays untouched, and it does. So it's booked on her side: **Wed 12:30–13:30, CSE455 staff meeting with Professor Alvarez**, her lunch now 12:00–12:30.

That leaves only your decision. Say go and I'll put CSE455 staff meeting Wed 12:30–13:30 in your calendar, move Research meeting to Wed 10:00–10:30, and log both. If you'd rather not, tell me and I'll have her line removed (logged DELETED) — no explanation needed on your part. Her fallbacks are a half-hour Wed 12:30–13:00 or another week.
Will do — I'll write the moment he confirms, and if it falls through I'll tell you and put the half-hour **Wed 12:30–13:00** to alvarez-agent as the fallback. Noted that you're fine with it.
